name: TMGMT Ignore Fields
description: Lets administrators exclude specific fields from TMGMT translation jobs.
project_description:
TMGMT Ignore Fields allows users to globally pick which fields should be skipped during translation.

 What it does 
 When translating content with TMGMT, sometimes you don't want every field to be translated. This module lets you:

 
 Globally select specific fields to exclude from translation 
 Create a list of fields that will always be ignored 
 Skip both base fields and custom fields from any content type 
 
 Usecases: 
 
 You can now ignore paragraphs and other referenced entities. 
 Globally ignore a field with just 1 click.
